The user wants to identify SMILES of an organic sample. No data provided. We need to infer from maybe spectra? But no spectra given. The only input is the task description. Possibly the sample is unknown; we need to use tools to get data? But we have no sample. Maybe the system expects we ask for spectra? However we have no sample ID. Could be that the environment already has a sample loaded (the "sample at hand") for which we can request spectra. Tools like proton_nmr_spectra, carbon_nmr_spectra, ir_spectra, mass_spectrometry_spectra, hsqc_nmr_spectra, return_possible_fragments, simulate_spectra. So we can request these to get data about the unknown sample. Then deduce structure.

We need to be efficient, minimize calls. Perhaps start with mass spectrometry to get molecular weight. Then get formula via isotope distribution? Actually mass spec will give m/z peaks. Use that to infer formula. Then use NMR to deduce structure.

Let's call mass_spectrometry_spectra.
